UI_ViewpointExtractionSupport_EnabledToo: Show a selected aircraft during Extraction Mode's final approach, boarding and departure. Requires Show event aircraft in Visible Helicopter Events and at least one selected, available aircraft.
UI_ViewpointExtractionSupport_HoverHeigh: Height above the extraction point while waiting for survivors to board. Does not change the extraction location or boarding rules.
UI_ViewpointExtractionSupport_ShowAreaTo: Show a translucent yellow cylinder during boarding, using Extraction Mode's boarding radius. Replaces the extraction arrow in Viewpoint while the marker is visible.
UI_ViewpointExtractionSupport_OnlyWithIn: Show Extraction Mode HUD only with inventory open
Hide the Extraction Mode panel unless the player inventory, loot window or supported inventory UI is open. Disabled by default.
UI_ViewpointExtractionSupport_UseNeatUI: Use NeatUI styling for Extraction Mode menus
UI_ViewpointExtractionSupport_UseNeatUIT: Use NeatUI panel and button styling when NeatUI_Framework is installed. Falls back to the normal Extraction Mode UI when unavailable. Enabled by default.
UI_ViewpointExtractionSupport_AircraftTo: Allow the UH-1B from UH-1B Helicopter to appear. Requires Aviation Core too. Selected by default.
